BFS strategy visits pages in breadth-first order

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"crawl_strategy\":\"bfs\",\"max_concurrent\":1,\"max_depth\":2}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.CrawlAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages.Count);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages[1].Url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages[2].Url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages[3].Url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages[4].Url);
```
